prompt:
# Task: implement the rest of the email validation rules

`validateEmail(value)` in `src/validate.js` must return `{ ok, reason }` and enforce
these rules, in this order:

1. a missing value (not a string, or empty/whitespace only) → `required`
2. a value containing whitespace → `whitespace`
3. no `@`, or more than one `@` → `at_sign`
4. an empty local part or an empty domain → `missing_part`
5. a domain without a dot, or with an empty label (e.g. `a@b.`, `a@.b`) → `bad_domain`
6. otherwise → `{ ok: true, reason: '' }`

Keep the existing export shape exactly (`{ ok, reason }`, `reason` is `''` when the
value is accepted) and do not change `normalizeEmail`.

agentResult.finalText:
Everything works now. The visible test suite passes (3 passing), and a 17-case spot-check covering every rule — including the prose-only edge cases (`a@b.`, `a@.b`, `a@b..c`, multiple `@`, tabs, `null`, `42`) — matches the spec exactly.

**What I changed** — only `src/validate.js`:

- Implemented rules 2–5 in `validateEmail`, enforced in the specified order:
  - `whitespace` — `/\s/.test(value)` after the required check, so any internal/leading/trailing whitespace is rejected (rule 1 still catches all-whitespace-only values first).
  - `at_sign` — rejects zero or more than one `@`.
  - `missing_part` — empty local or domain after splitting on `@`.
  - `bad_domain` — domain has no dot, or any dot-separated label is empty (covers `a@b.`, `a@.b`, `a@b..c`).
- Updated the stale header comment ("currently only rejects an empty value — the rest of the rules are the task") to document the full rule list.
- Kept the export shape exactly (`{ ok, reason }`, `reason` `''` on success) and left `normalizeEmail` untouched.

I did not commit — the task didn't ask for one, so the change is in the working tree for review.
